items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: there was a fellow there, Jesse Johnson, who had a restaurant downstairs... and that's where he was playing.

ctx.x: You remember the name of the place that Jimmy Blanton was playing?

No it was one of-- there was a fellow there, Jesse Johnson, who had a restaurant downstairs, had one of these little after-hour night spots upstairs, there, and that's where he was playing. Course all of them are extinct now. There's no more club, no more restaurant, or no more anything on that street anymore.
How old was Jimmy Blanton? Very young wasn't he?
